verdict: Plays clean: cleared, no console error, every spot reachable; the caravan, the rival (Mum), the trial, the Sand Tyrant (the Red Jackal's model, tinted) and the gate (Nyx; second try) all played.

found.title: The shut lair holds
found.text: Checked because a picture run seemed to start the ruler early (it was the run's own door, at the end): from five spots outside, on floors 2, 12, 22 and 27, a hero walking at the shut lair never starts its fight; the door only opens to the quest (scenery.ts `ready`). On floors 2, 22 and 27 the hero can walk round the end of the shut wall and stand on the door's spot; nothing happens there.

found.title: The Sand Tyrant hits hard early
found.text: A hero who stands still in his hall falls in about 7 s (the bot, fighting, won with nearly all its health): a boss, not a fault.

found.title: Props
found.text: A mesa past the north edge on its own high ground, the lair wall's gold edge into the dune, crates on the rim's slope, red rocks a little sunk.
